item.title: Obama Library To Feature Interactive Exhibit Where Visitors Can Print Their Own Birth Certificates
item.description: CHICAGO, IL — According to early reviews, the new Obama Presidential Center boasts an exciting interactive exhibit for all ages where guests can make their own birth certificate.

item.title: Iran Boasts It Has Destroyed Hundreds Of US Missiles With Its Buildings
item.description: TEHRAN — As the conflict in the Middle East stretched into a second week, the Iranian government issued a public statement boasting that it had destroyed hundreds of U.S. missiles with its buildings.

item.title: David French Praises Satan As 'Most Christian Person In History'
item.description: CHICAGO, IL — Political commentator and columnist for The New York Times David French praised Satan on Monday, calling the great red dragon the most Christian person in history.

item.title: Mamdani Clarifies That His Wife Only Celebrates Terrorism In Her Capacity As A Private Citizen
item.description: NEW YORK, NY — Mayor Zohram Mandani called a press conference on Monday to clarify that his wife only celebrates the actions and mission of terrorists in her capacity as a private citizen.

item.title: Europe Under Persistent Delusion Anyone Cares What It Thinks
item.description: BRUSSELS — As all eyes around the globe remained fixed on the ongoing U.S.-Iran conflict, leaders gathered for an important summit in a clear display that Europe remained under its persistent delusion that anyone cares what it thinks.

item.title: 8 Powerful Ways To Elevate Women On International Women's Day
item.description: If you missed celebrating International Women's Day yesterday, it's not too late to solemnly observe it in a variety of meaningful ways.
